# test-apps

Reference test applications for the 280 platform.

## Do not edit

**At no point should the code inside this folder be edited.** These apps are frozen fixtures.

This folder exists only to serve as test apps that agents refactor **in a separate place** and attempt to push into the 280 platform. Treat everything here as read-only source material: copy an app out, work on the copy elsewhere, and never modify the originals in place.

## Apps

- `1-google-sheets-original` — Next.js Google Sheets sample app.
